How well does the 700 kWh block threshold in Eversource's proposed Rate 6 match
actual pre-heat-pump monthly electricity use? Rate 6 assumes that all homes consume
roughly 700 kWh per month during the winter heating season (November–March), and
charges a lower Block 2 rate only on kWh above that threshold. If a home's baseline
usage is well below 700, the discount never kicks in — even after a heat pump is
installed, most of the incremental load lands in Block 1 at the full rate. If a home's
baseline usage is well above 700, the discount applies to kWh that are not actually
incremental heat pump load.

This notebook visualizes the distribution of pre-heat-pump monthly electricity
consumption during winter months across CT Eversource homes to assess how
representative the 700 kWh threshold is.

## Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup

from __future__ import annotations

import pickle
from pathlib import Path

import plotnine as plt
import polars as pl
import yaml

from lib.plotnine import SB_COLORS, theme_switchbox
from lib.quarto import display_svg
from lib.rates_analysis.rate_case_funcs import (
    MONTH_ORDER,
    add_heating_label,
    fair_rate_heating_types,
    load_master_bills,
    segment_name,
    weighted_quantile,
)
from lib.rdp import fetch_rdp_file
```

```{python}
#| label: params

_batch_config = yaml.safe_load(Path("../batch_config.yaml").read_text())

STATE = _batch_config["STATE"]
BATCH = _batch_config["BATCH"]
RDP_REF = _batch_config["RDP_REF"]
UTILITY = "ct_eversource"
FAIR_RATE_POPULATION = _batch_config["FAIR_RATE_POPULATION"]
DEFAULT_SCENARIO = _batch_config["BASELINE_BILL_SCENARIO"]

SEG_DEFAULT_PRECALC = segment_name(DEFAULT_SCENARIO, "precalc")

THRESHOLD_KWH = 700.0

# Winter months from the periods YAML
_period_yaml = yaml.safe_load(
    fetch_rdp_file(
        f"rate_design/hp_rates/{STATE.lower()}/config/periods/{UTILITY}.yaml",
        ref=RDP_REF,
    )
)
WINTER_MONTHS: list[int] = _period_yaml["winter_months"]
WINTER_MONTH_LABELS: list[str] = [
    MONTH_ORDER[m - 1] for m in sorted(WINTER_MONTHS, key=lambda m: (m % 12, m))
]
FAIR_RATE_HTS = fair_rate_heating_types(FAIR_RATE_POPULATION)

print(f"state={STATE}  batch={BATCH}  utility={UTILITY}")
print(f"winter_months={WINTER_MONTHS} → {WINTER_MONTH_LABELS}")
print(f"threshold={THRESHOLD_KWH} kWh")
```

## Load pre-heat-pump monthly electricity

We load monthly `elec_grid_kwh` from the upgrade-0 (pre-heat-pump) precalc segment,
restricted to Eversource buildings and winter months only. This is the consumption
that Rate 6's 700 kWh block threshold is meant to approximate.

```{python}
#| label: load-monthly-kwh

monthly_winter = (
    load_master_bills(STATE, BATCH, SEG_DEFAULT_PRECALC)
    .filter(
        (pl.col("sb.electric_utility") == UTILITY)
        & (pl.col("month").is_in(WINTER_MONTH_LABELS))
    )
    .select(
        "bldg_id",
        "weight",
        "month",
        pl.col("elec_grid_kwh").alias("monthly_kwh"),
        "postprocess_group.heating_type_v2",
    )
    .collect()
)

monthly_winter = add_heating_label(
    monthly_winter, code_col="postprocess_group.heating_type_v2"
)

print(f"{monthly_winter.height:,} building-months")
print(f"{monthly_winter['bldg_id'].n_unique():,} unique buildings")
monthly_winter.head(10)
```

Let's see what heating types we have and how many buildings fall in each.

```{python}
#| label: heating-type-counts

ht_counts = (
    monthly_winter.group_by("heating_label")
    .agg(
        pl.col("bldg_id").n_unique().alias("n_buildings"),
        pl.col("weight").first().sum().alias("weighted_count"),
    )
    .sort("n_buildings", descending=True)
)
ht_counts
```

For the faceted histogram we group into two populations: natural gas and delivered
fuels (oil/propane). These are the populations Rate 6 is designed for — homes
switching from fossil heating to heat pumps.

```{python}
#| label: fuel-group

fuel_group_map = {
    "Natural gas": "Natural gas",
    "Oil/propane": "Oil/propane",
}

monthly_fossil = monthly_winter.filter(
    pl.col("postprocess_group.heating_type_v2").is_in(FAIR_RATE_HTS)
).with_columns(
    pl.col("heating_label")
    .replace_strict(fuel_group_map, default="Other")
    .alias("fuel_group")
).filter(pl.col("fuel_group") != "Other")

print(f"{monthly_fossil.height:,} building-months across fossil-heated homes")
print(f"{monthly_fossil['bldg_id'].n_unique():,} unique buildings")
monthly_fossil["fuel_group"].value_counts(sort=True)
```

## Dispersion statistics

Before plotting, let's compute the weighted mean, median, standard deviation,
and key percentiles of monthly winter kWh across all fossil-fuel-heated homes.

```{python}
#| label: dispersion-stats

def weighted_stats(df: pl.DataFrame, col: str = "monthly_kwh") -> dict:
    """Compute weighted summary statistics for a column."""
    w = df["weight"]
    x = df[col]
    total_w = w.sum()
    w_mean = float((x * w).sum() / total_w)
    w_var = float(((x - w_mean) ** 2 * w).sum() / total_w)
    w_std = w_var**0.5
    w_median = weighted_quantile(df.select(pl.col(col), "weight"), col, 0.5)
    w_p10 = weighted_quantile(df.select(pl.col(col), "weight"), col, 0.10)
    w_p25 = weighted_quantile(df.select(pl.col(col), "weight"), col, 0.25)
    w_p75 = weighted_quantile(df.select(pl.col(col), "weight"), col, 0.75)
    w_p90 = weighted_quantile(df.select(pl.col(col), "weight"), col, 0.90)
    pct_below = float((df.filter(pl.col(col) < THRESHOLD_KWH)["weight"].sum()) / total_w)
    pct_above = float((df.filter(pl.col(col) >= THRESHOLD_KWH)["weight"].sum()) / total_w)
    return {
        "mean": w_mean,
        "median": w_median,
        "std": w_std,
        "p10": w_p10,
        "p25": w_p25,
        "p75": w_p75,
        "p90": w_p90,
        "pct_below_threshold": pct_below,
        "pct_above_threshold": pct_above,
        "cv": w_std / w_mean if w_mean else 0,
    }


stats_all = weighted_stats(monthly_fossil)
stats_natgas = weighted_stats(monthly_fossil.filter(pl.col("fuel_group") == "Natural gas"))
stats_delivered = weighted_stats(monthly_fossil.filter(pl.col("fuel_group") == "Oil/propane"))

for label, s in [("All fossil", stats_all), ("Natural gas", stats_natgas), ("Oil/propane", stats_delivered)]:
    print(f"\n--- {label} ---")
    print(f"  Mean:   {s['mean']:,.0f} kWh")
    print(f"  Median: {s['median']:,.0f} kWh")
    print(f"  Std:    {s['std']:,.0f} kWh")
    print(f"  CV:     {s['cv']:.2f}")
    print(f"  P10:    {s['p10']:,.0f} kWh")
    print(f"  P25:    {s['p25']:,.0f} kWh")
    print(f"  P75:    {s['p75']:,.0f} kWh")
    print(f"  P90:    {s['p90']:,.0f} kWh")
    print(f"  Below {THRESHOLD_KWH:.0f} kWh: {s['pct_below_threshold']:.1%}")
    print(f"  At or above {THRESHOLD_KWH:.0f} kWh: {s['pct_above_threshold']:.1%}")
```

## Histogram: all fossil-heated homes

The histogram shows the distribution of monthly electricity consumption during winter
months (November–March) for all fossil-fuel-heated CT Eversource homes, *before*
switching to a heat pump. The vertical dashed line at 700 kWh marks Rate 6's block
threshold — everything to the left is billed at the full Block 1 rate under Rate 6.

```{python}
#| label: fig-winter-kwh-hist-all
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of pre-heat-pump monthly electricity consumption during winter months (November–March) for all fossil-fuel-heated CT Eversource homes. Dashed line at 700 kWh marks Rate 6's block threshold."

_xlim_lo = weighted_quantile(monthly_fossil.select("monthly_kwh", "weight"), "monthly_kwh", 0.005)
_xlim_hi = weighted_quantile(monthly_fossil.select("monthly_kwh", "weight"), "monthly_kwh", 0.995)

_mean_all = stats_all["mean"]

p = (
    plt.ggplot(monthly_fossil, plt.aes(x="monthly_kwh", weight="weight"))
    + plt.geom_histogram(binwidth=50, fill=SB_COLORS["sky"], color="white", alpha=0.85)
    + plt.geom_vline(xintercept=THRESHOLD_KWH, linetype="dashed", color=SB_COLORS["carrot"], size=1)
    + plt.annotate(
        "text",
        x=THRESHOLD_KWH + 20,
        y=float("inf"),
        label=f"{THRESHOLD_KWH:.0f} kWh",
        va="top",
        ha="left",
        color=SB_COLORS["carrot"],
        size=11,
        fontweight="bold",
    )
    + plt.geom_vline(xintercept=_mean_all, linetype="solid", color=SB_COLORS["midnight"], size=0.8)
    + plt.annotate(
        "text",
        x=_mean_all - 20,
        y=float("inf"),
        label=f"Mean: {_mean_all:,.0f} kWh",
        va="top",
        ha="right",
        color=SB_COLORS["midnight"],
        size=11,
        fontweight="bold",
    )
    + plt.scale_x_continuous(
        labels=lambda vals: [f"{v:,.0f}" for v in vals],
    )
    + plt.scale_y_continuous(
        labels=lambda vals: [f"{v:,.0f}" for v in vals],
    )
    + plt.coord_cartesian(xlim=(_xlim_lo, _xlim_hi))
    + plt.labs(
        x="Monthly electricity (kWh)",
        y="Weighted building-months",
        title="Pre-heat-pump winter electricity use vs. Rate 6's 700 kWh threshold",
        subtitle=f"Fossil-fuel-heated homes, Nov–Mar · Mean: {stats_all['mean']:,.0f} kWh · Median: {stats_all['median']:,.0f} kWh · {stats_all['pct_below_threshold']:.0%} below threshold",
    )
    + theme_switchbox()
    + plt.theme(figure_size=(10.5, 5))
)
display_svg(p.draw())
```

## Histogram: faceted by fuel type

The same distribution, faceted by baseline heating fuel. Natural-gas-heated homes
and oil/propane-heated homes may have very different baseline electricity use,
which affects how well the 700 kWh threshold discriminates between base load and
incremental heat pump load for each group.

```{python}
#| label: fig-winter-kwh-hist-by-fuel
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of pre-heat-pump monthly electricity consumption during winter months, faceted by baseline heating fuel. Dashed line at 700 kWh marks Rate 6's block threshold."

_fuel_order = pl.Enum(["Natural gas", "Oil/propane"])
_df_facet = monthly_fossil.with_columns(
    pl.col("fuel_group").cast(_fuel_order)
)

_subtitle_parts = []
for fg, s in [("Natural gas", stats_natgas), ("Oil/propane", stats_delivered)]:
    _subtitle_parts.append(
        f"{fg}: mean {s['mean']:,.0f}, median {s['median']:,.0f}, {s['pct_below_threshold']:.0%} below"
    )
_subtitle = " · ".join(_subtitle_parts)

_facet_means = pl.DataFrame({
    "fuel_group": ["Natural gas", "Oil/propane"],
    "mean_kwh": [stats_natgas["mean"], stats_delivered["mean"]],
}).with_columns(pl.col("fuel_group").cast(_fuel_order))

_facet_labels = _facet_means.with_columns(
    (
        pl.lit("Mean: ")
        + pl.col("mean_kwh").round(0).cast(pl.Int64).cast(pl.Utf8)
        + pl.lit(" kWh")
    ).alias("label"),
    pl.when(pl.col("mean_kwh") >= THRESHOLD_KWH)
    .then(pl.col("mean_kwh") + 20)
    .otherwise(pl.col("mean_kwh") - 20)
    .alias("label_x"),
)
_labels_left = _facet_labels.filter(pl.col("mean_kwh") < THRESHOLD_KWH)
_labels_right = _facet_labels.filter(pl.col("mean_kwh") >= THRESHOLD_KWH)

_mean_layers: list = [
    plt.geom_vline(
        _facet_means,
        plt.aes(xintercept="mean_kwh"),
        linetype="solid",
        color=SB_COLORS["midnight"],
        size=0.8,
        inherit_aes=False,
    ),
]
if _labels_left.height > 0:
    _mean_layers.append(
        plt.geom_text(
            _labels_left,
            plt.aes(x="label_x", label="label"),
            y=float("inf"),
            va="top",
            ha="right",
            color=SB_COLORS["midnight"],
            size=11,
            fontweight="bold",
            inherit_aes=False,
        )
    )
if _labels_right.height > 0:
    _mean_layers.append(
        plt.geom_text(
            _labels_right,
            plt.aes(x="label_x", label="label"),
            y=float("inf"),
            va="top",
            ha="left",
            color=SB_COLORS["midnight"],
            size=11,
            fontweight="bold",
            inherit_aes=False,
        )
    )

p_facet = (
    plt.ggplot(_df_facet, plt.aes(x="monthly_kwh", weight="weight"))
    + plt.geom_histogram(binwidth=50, fill=SB_COLORS["sky"], color="white", alpha=0.85)
    + plt.geom_vline(xintercept=THRESHOLD_KWH, linetype="dashed", color=SB_COLORS["carrot"], size=1)
    + plt.annotate(
        "text",
        x=THRESHOLD_KWH + 20,
        y=float("inf"),
        label=f"{THRESHOLD_KWH:.0f} kWh",
        va="top",
        ha="left",
        color=SB_COLORS["carrot"],
        size=11,
        fontweight="bold",
    )
    + _mean_layers
    + plt.facet_wrap("fuel_group", ncol=1, scales="free_y")
    + plt.scale_x_continuous(
        labels=lambda vals: [f"{v:,.0f}" for v in vals],
    )
    + plt.scale_y_continuous(
        labels=lambda vals: [f"{v:,.0f}" for v in vals],
    )
    + plt.coord_cartesian(xlim=(_xlim_lo, _xlim_hi))
    + plt.labs(
        x="Monthly electricity (kWh)",
        y="Weighted building-months",
        title="Pre-heat-pump winter electricity by heating fuel vs. Rate 6's 700 kWh threshold",
        subtitle=_subtitle,
    )
    + theme_switchbox()
    + plt.theme(figure_size=(10.5, 7.5))
)
display_svg(p_facet.draw())
```

## Export report variables

```{python}
#| label: export-report-vars

report_vars: dict = {}

report_vars["threshold_kwh"] = THRESHOLD_KWH

for label, s in [("all_fossil", stats_all), ("natgas", stats_natgas), ("delivered", stats_delivered)]:
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_mean_{label}"] = s["mean"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_median_{label}"] = s["median"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_std_{label}"] = s["std"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_cv_{label}"] = s["cv"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_p10_{label}"] = s["p10"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_p25_{label}"] = s["p25"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_p75_{label}"] = s["p75"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_p90_{label}"] = s["p90"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_pct_below_{label}"] = s["pct_below_threshold"]
    report_vars[f"winter_kwh_pct_above_{label}"] = s["pct_above_threshold"]

Path("../cache").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path("../cache/rate6_threshold_report_variables.pkl").write_bytes(pickle.dumps(report_vars))
print(f"Exported {len(report_vars)} report vars to cache/rate6_threshold_report_variables.pkl")
report_vars
```
